scope: Literature search used public primary papers and author implementations only; no clinical text in web searches or paid API calls. Later authorized Codex source review is recorded separately in semantic_B artifacts.

papers.title: Just Train Twice: Improving Group Robustness without Training Group Information
papers.decision: Static training-side difficulty coverage is worth a matched control; teacher disagreement is not the identification model training-error set and must not be called JTT.

papers.title: MedNLI Is Not Immune: Natural Language Inference Artifacts in the Clinical Domain
papers.decision: Use a fixed patient-grouped claim-only diagnostic and majority baseline, never a surrogate for 9B effectiveness or evidence understanding.

papers.title: The Foundations of Cost-Sensitive Learning
papers.decision: Class weights, asymmetric false-S costs and NS/NA discrimination are distinct; weight updates do not prove representation improvement.

papers.title: Distilling Step-by-Step! Outperforming Larger Language Models with Less Training Data and Smaller Model Sizes
papers.decision: Its two task-prefixed forward passes are not task 105 single-sequence segmented loss; do not treat either result as direct replication or refutation.

papers.title_v1: Supervised Fine-tuning with Synthetic Rationale Data Hurts Real-World Disease Prediction
papers.title_v2: Rethinking Synthetic Rationale Supervision for Disease Prediction
papers.official_code_status: No independently verifiable author training repository linked on checked official arXiv pages.
papers.decision: Label-first recovery refutes universal rationale-harm claims; future disease prediction differs from three-way evidence verification. Do not add a rationale-rescue arm to task 106.

limitations: No new clinical gold or 9B effectiveness estimate is supplied by these papers.
Web material was inspected at method and experiment sections; no external repositories were installed or executed.
The weighted-CE and three-class cost derivations in literature.md are explicit local derivations, not empirical guarantees.
